test_name: A shape-mode breve under cnb:breve-style 'tied, on the Configurator's default notehead (crotchet-minim
description: Session 45. With cnb:breve-style 'tied and (repeat . #f), a breve engraves as two tied semibreves: two copies of the head, the second's left edge 1 staff space after the first's right edge, and one tie below from the first head's centre to the second's, on the Configurator's default notehead (crotchet-minim, its cutout), black, 4 semitones per staff space, the 4-8 staff, at cnb:multinote-overlap 1/3. The harvest measures a head by its path's control-point hull, 0.929 wide against the stencil's 0.8621 (the brief's w), so widths are the single head's hull plus the steps the rule gives in stencil widths. Positions are SVG units, 1 staff space each. The harvest gives one box, colour and path per notehead, so the tie's ends and its colour (drawn outside the head's colour group, so black on the red C sharp too) are read from the SVG in the handoff (docs/session-sets/045-shape-mode-breve/configurator-handoff.md).

assertions.description: Six noteheads: two semibreves (the single head, the reference) and four breves
The second semibreve is the same single head

assertions._comment: === SECTION 2: EACH BREVE IS ONE NOTEHEAD, TIED ===

assertions.description: The breve, E5 on the staff: one notehead, its first head the single head's path (outline and cutout) in black, the second's left edge 1 staff space after the first's right edge, so its hull is the single head's plus 0.8621 + 1; the tie below takes its height to 1.342 (the tie's control-point hull, measured on 2.24 and 2.26); its top is the single head's at the same pitch

The breve, C5 on its ledgers: one notehead, its first head the single head's path (outline and cutout) in black, the second's left edge 1 staff space after the first's right edge, so its hull is the single head's plus 0.8621 + 1; the tie below takes its height to 1.342 (the tie's control-point hull, measured on 2.24 and 2.26)

The breve, D5 on its ledgers: one notehead, its first head the single head's path (outline and cutout) in black, the second's left edge 1 staff space after the first's right edge, so its hull is the single head's plus 0.8621 + 1; the tie below takes its height to 1.342 (the tie's control-point hull, measured on 2.24 and 2.26)

The breve, the dotted E5: one notehead, its first head the single head's path (outline and cutout) in black, the second's left edge 1 staff space after the first's right edge, so its hull is the single head's plus 0.8621 + 1; the tie below takes its height to 1.342 (the tie's control-point hull, measured on 2.24 and 2.26)

One ledger element spans the two ledgered breves' ledgers (C5 at position 0, D5 at positions 0 and 1, from cnb:ledgers-by-semitone): its height is positions 0 and 1, half a staff space apart, plus the 0.2 thickness; each breve's ledgers are 1.5 times the whole stencil's width (2 * 0.8621 + 1), so the element is the distance between the two breves plus 1.5 x 2 * 0.8621 + 1, and it starts 0.667 before the first one's hull (0.25 x the stencil width before its left edge); the breves on the staff have none
The dotted breve's dot stands after the whole stencil, close to it
